name: Spinach AI
description: Connect Claude to your Spinach AI meeting history. Access summaries, key decisions, and action items from your team syncs directly within your workflow. Ask Claude questions about recent discussions, track open tasks, and recall specific project details. Use your meeting context to seamlessly draft follow-up emails, project updates, and strategy documents without leaving the chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Spinach AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Spinach AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.spinach.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Spinach AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spinach AI provides these MCP tools: TestConnection, Search, and Fetch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Spinach AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Spinach AI in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Spinach AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spinach AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Spinach AI is developed by Spinach AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
